reviews.text: My go to shop for pets food. Large variety of all you need for cats. Also open on Sundays and until 6pm in the evening. Very convenient.
Helpful staff
Big store, lots of choice and good price

We got our two Orandas here. They are strong and healthy fish. They check if you have knowledge of these fish, as goldfish are social animals and somewhat more difficult to care for. They also inquire whether you have enough space for them.

Blib and Blub have been with us for over two years now; they lie sleeping together very contentedly and frolic happily around.
Extremely expensive.

Today I came to this store to buy two small Japanese goldfish for my little daughters. Even though my aquarium is 100 liters, the woman at the counter refused to give me the fish, saying my aquarium was too small. I researched it later and it was completely untrue... She just made up a ridiculous excuse because it was too difficult to remove the fish from the aquarium. I encountered a similar situation on my previous visit. It's an extremely pointless place with low-quality service. It's also a fiasco that my two daughters, who came with me to buy fish, were upset... If you're not going to sell them, why did you open this store?!
Nice big store with wide assortment
Pets place and Aldi under one roof, what more could you want?!
Unfortunately, you always miss out on something here. Empty shelves

Because you always have the dog treats at my calf height and my dog's nose height, you have to navigate your store incredibly relaxed.

Which is always wrong. Today was no exception. I'd found the dog food, now I was looking for the tripe treats. The English-speaking woman had no idea, the Dutch-speaking woman showed up with the bull tendon. Indeed, only one letter difference.

Because I was trudging back and forth behind them with the dog food in one arm, I realized too late that my dog ​​had seized the opportunity in the other arm and had already half-eaten some kind of croquette.

At the checkout, there was an extra €3.15 on my receipt. For that croquette. I find this ridiculous.

I understand that my dog ​​isn't supposed to devour your store like a proletarian. But hopefully, you also understand that this wasn't MY intention. And it seems like that's your intention, given the height of the shelves.

But, as I just discovered, luckily my dog ​​food is also readily available online.

Tabé Pets Place.
This is my regular shop where I always buy the supplies for my Somali. Friendly staff and a wide range of products.
Sure
Amazing place with lots of things to select from! I needed a lot of help and the staff were so patient and helpful with me! I recommend this place.

After buying a toy for my kitten, I gave it to her immediately upon arriving home. Within a minute, my entire house and my kitten were covered in catnip. For the amount I paid for this toy, I found this truly ridiculous. After waiting two weeks for a response, Alina from customer service informed me that this is not their responsibility. A very disappointing experience.
I have no idea how is it possible to not have any shopping bags available in the middle of a day. Therefore, I couldn’t buy what I wanted
The staff is always friendly and the store has a large stock and is super tidy!
Perfect customer service, they know what they sell and they like their job. You will find anything you need here.
Two very disinterested English-speaking girls who seem completely unwilling to help. They couldn't crack a smile and wouldn't even look at you.
I like the store only what I really don’t like the girl dind want to give me 2 goldfish! She say only 1 I never seen this before now I have to go to another store te buy another fish😒 …
Always top-notch! Staff amazing... nice selection. The price-quality ratio is great compared to Dier en Ranzijn..
It is a shame that as a customer you are spoken to in English. The Italian employees, however, do not speak a word of Dutch. Pets Place, you could do better.
All very kind and helpful who work here
This store has everything I need for my dog. They have a wide variety of products for many animals. The staff are friendly and helpful.
If you want to come here for aquarium plants, don't. The water quality is terrible and the plants are all spoiled. It's still sold under the guise of "that's how nature is."
Large choice of products, fair prices and very friendly staff. In my opinion the best pet shop in Amsterdam, highly recommend.
They have a wide range of products for cats and dogs. You can easily find what you're looking for. The prices are also good.
I didn't get the feeling that the woman behind the counter wanted to help me with my question about specific food.
Update opening hours
You can find everything related to animals there, like a supermarket, even live fish and hamsters.

I cannot recommend this store. The focus is clearly on sales and not on customer service or the well-being of the animals. The staff seem to be more salespeople than animal lovers and have little knowledge of what is best for the animals.

I prefer going to a real pet store, where the shop was started out of love for animals and is not simply part of a large chain. There you get personal service and advice from people who truly care about the animals. Support your local shops; you will have a much better experience!
Amazing store for pets. Everything you need and very kind and helpful personnel. Highly recommended.
